_why: The selected-finding receiver resolves chip.parameters.block_id against rebuilt blocks. Its whole premise is that block_id is re-derivable as uuidv5('{prefix}:{key}:{graph_hash}'). This corpus is what makes that testable against production bytes rather than against ids this repo minted for itself.
